name: Waves
summary: Waveform or spectrum rows receding in perspective, the Unknown Pleasures landscape.
credit: The stacked-waveform landscape made famous by the Unknown Pleasures cover (Peter Saville, after a pulsar plot by Harold Craft): the look only.
hint: Each row is one slice of the signal; rows march toward the horizon and hide what is behind them (or, Solid off, glow through each other). With a palette, age runs the colours front to back, or level colours the loud rows.

params.label: Spectrum
params.help: Each band: every band against its own recent best, so all of them move whatever the mix. In balance: the bands on one scale, so a bass-heavy track looks bass-heavy and quiet bands stay quiet.

params.label: Solid
params.help: On: each row hides what is behind it. Off: the rows are see-through lines that add up as light, like stacked oscilloscope traces.

params.label: Glow
params.help: A soft halo round each line.
